svg.title: How a weekly review runs
svg.desc: Hand-drawn picture of the built runtime. The officer starts a command. A planner proposes one next step. A dispatcher either refuses it or runs one of four tools. Extraction and policy sit outside the loop.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

svg.text: Built system - Gemini does not pick the next tool

svg.text: Who is calling? Is this tool allowed on this step? Is the request well formed?

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

svg.text: If no, refuse and write nothing. If yes, run the tool, check the reply, scan it, log it.
